Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

At MRA Bakery, we specialize in handcrafted bread, pastries, cakes, and savory snacks, offering custom-tailored edible art to meet your unique needs. We also proudly supply our high-quality baked goods to established coffee chains. For events, MRA Catering provides exceptional catering services for weddings, anniversaries, school functions, festive gatherings, and more. Our menu features traditional sweets and snacks, including Biriyani, Halal-certified non-vegetarian dishes, desserts, breads, halwas, a variety of cakes and pastries, cashew sweets, savory snacks, and chaat. We also elevate Indian desserts with unique flavors like rose, saffron, and mango, ensuring a memorable culinary experience for every occasion. 

Here are some of our delicious cakes:
1. **Pista Cake**: Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar, sandwiched with vanilla fresh cream and pista, decorated with pista flakes. Price: ₹949. ![Pista Cake](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_122311.png)
2. **Blackcurrant Cake**: Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched and topped with vanilla fresh cream & black currant crush. Price: ₹899. ![Blackcurrant Cake](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_122412.png)
3. **Kiwi Cake**: Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched with vanilla fresh cream and kiwi jello. Price: ₹820. ![Kiwi Cake](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_121846.png)
4. **Mango Cake**: Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched with vanilla fresh cream and mango jello. Price: ₹820. ![Mango Cake](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_121919.png)
5. **Blueberry Cake**: Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched with vanilla fresh cream and blueberry jello. Price: ₹820.
